row.name: Bio-Rad Laboratories Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=24 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.34 tightness=0.86 base_volume_vs_leg=0.88 base_volume_vs_avg=0.96
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 24 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -2.0% vs its 20-SMA, -4.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Both RE and VOL are hard FAILs: the burst bar's range is only 45% of the prior 5-bar maximum and volume came in at 87% of the prior session and 82% of the 50-session average — well below the 1.5x catalyst threshold required for a 24-session base. The base itself is 24 sessions (outside the 3–20 window, PARTIAL C) with a tightness of 0.86 and one breakdown, and visually the shaded box shows wide, overlapping bars with the price drifting lower through most of the consolidation period. These two measured FAILs together with the loose, extended base are the decisive quality problems.
claude.key_risk: The burst bar lacks range expansion and volume confirmation, meaning there is no evidence of institutional accumulation driving the move out of a base that is already too long and too loose.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 369.14 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below average, confirming the lack of institutional interest.
